description: This file contains the implementation of a generic serializer for the MapField class, used in serialization within the Orleans framework. It defines a MapFieldCodec class that handles reading and writing MapField objects, including managing references, field headers, and nested key-value pairs.

classes.name: MapFieldCodec<TKey, TValue>
classes.description: A serializer class for MapField objects, capable of serializing and deserializing map collections with custom key and value codecs.

methods.name: WriteField
methods.description: Serializes a MapField object to the specified buffer writer.

methods.name: ReadValue
methods.description: Deserializes data from the reader into a MapField object.

methods.name: CreateInstance
methods.description: Creates a new MapField instance and records it in the serialization session.

methods.name: ThrowInvalidSizeException
methods.description: Throws an exception if the encountered size exceeds expected limits.

methods.name: ThrowLengthFieldMissing
methods.description: Throws an exception if the length field is missing in the serialized data.
